metadata.sourcePromptSummary: Edge-Mounted Linear Alignment System for Mold Generation

1_problemDefinition.goal: Replace scattered spherical registration locators with a professional, deterministic, edge-mounted linear tongue-and-groove alignment system across all mold mating interfaces.
1_problemDefinition.cadContext: Engineering vertical SaaS mold generator engine in Z-up millimeters operating on Manifold CSG solids and BVH distance fields.
1_problemDefinition.expectedOutcome: Complementary Linear Alignment Tongue and Linear Alignment Groove features placed deterministically on outer side corridors of mating interfaces, respecting asymmetry, assembly direction, and split intersection protection zones.

geometricConstraints: No key shall appear in the central region of a mating interface
Two-part mold must generate exactly 2 logical registration keys (left and right side corridors)
Four-part mold keys must form a globally coordinated perimeter framework
Intersection protection zone around split intersections must remain clear
Keys must maintain minimum wall thickness from cavity, sprue, and outer mold block boundaries
topologicalConstraints: Resulting mold bodies must remain 2-manifold closed solids with exactly one connected component
No detached fragments, zero-volume slivers, or non-manifold edges
performanceConstraints: Interface detection and corridor extraction under 200ms per pass
Manifold CSG Boolean execution faster than legacy spherical locators

6_algorithmPipeline.description: Construct mating interface graph between contacting mold bodies and classify local coordinate frames.
Extract left, right, top, and bottom edge corridors for each mating interface, subtracting cavity, sprue, thin wall, and intersection protection zones.
Plan deterministic linear keys along edge corridors (left+right for vertical interfaces, top+bottom for horizontal interfaces) enforcing continuous or minimal collinear segmented layout.
Apply deterministic asymmetry (for 2-part orientation control) and assign male/female roles based on supported wall thickness and assembly directions.
Perform Manifold CSG union of tapered tongue tools into male bodies and subtraction of clearanced groove tools from female bodies with 2-manifold validation.

7_failureConditions.condition: Usable edge corridors are obstructed by cavity/sprue or fail wall thickness validation
7_failureConditions.recoveryAction: Preserve untouched canonical mold bodies and report specific corridor obstruction.

7_failureConditions.condition: CSG Boolean creates non-manifold or multi-component geometry
7_failureConditions.recoveryAction: Roll back to input bodies and return detailed failure report.

8_edgeCases.scenario: Cavity or sprue intersects continuous side corridor
8_edgeCases.mitigation: Split key into minimal collinear aligned segments meeting minimum segment viability length.

8_edgeCases.scenario: Four-part split plane crossing at center
8_edgeCases.mitigation: Enforce adaptive protected spherical/cylindrical exclusion zone around intersection line.

transitions: generating -> blocked: geometric impossibility or insufficient wall

decisionClassifications.item: Edge-mounted linear tongue and groove alignment system
Exactly two keys (left/right) for two-part molds with orientation asymmetry
Protected intersection zone around split plane crossings
Adaptive parameter sizing derived from corridor width and wall thickness
